paragraphs.text: 1. GLADDEN the yearning Gods, O thou Most Youthful: bring them, O Lord of Seasons, knowing seasons,
paragraphs.original: पिप्रीहि देवाँ उशतो यविष्ठ विद्वाँ ऋतूँरृतुपते यजेह ।
paragraphs.translit: piprīhi devām̐ uśato yaviṣṭha vidvām̐ ṛtūm̐rṛtupate yajeha |

paragraphs.text: With all the Priests Celestial, O Agni. Best worshipper art thou of all Invokers.
2. Thine is the Herald's, thine the Cleanser's office, thinker art thou, wealth-giver, true to Order.
paragraphs.original: वेषि होत्रमुत पोत्रं जनानां मन्धातासि द्रविणोदा ऋतावा ।
paragraphs.translit: veṣi hotramuta potraṃ janānāṃ mandhātāsi draviṇodā ṛtāvā |

paragraphs.text: Let us with Svaha offer up oblations, and Agni, worthy God, pay the Gods worship.
paragraphs.original: स्वाहा वयं कृणवामा हवींषि देवो देवान्यजत्वग्निरर्हन्
paragraphs.translit: svāhā vayaṃ kṛṇavāmā havīṃṣi devo devānyajatvagnirarhan

paragraphs.text: 3. To the Gods' pathway have we travelled, ready to execute what work we may accomplish.
paragraphs.original: आ देवानामपि पन्थामगन्म यच्छक्नवाम तदनु प्रवोळ्हुम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ā devānāmapi panthāmaganma yacchaknavāma tadanu pravoḷhum |

paragraphs.text: Let Agni, for he knows, complete the worship. He is the Priest: let him fix rites and seasons.
paragraphs.original: अग्निर्विद्वान्स यजात्सेदु होता सो अध्वरान्स ऋतून्कल्पयाति
paragraphs.translit: agnirvidvānsa yajātsedu hotā so adhvarānsa ṛtūnkalpayāti

paragraphs.text: 4. When we most ignorant neglect the statutes of you, O Deities with whom is knowledge,
paragraphs.original: यद्वो वयं प्रमिनाम व्रतानि विदुषां देवा अविदुष्टरासः ।
paragraphs.translit: yadvo vayaṃ pramināma vratāni viduṣāṃ devā aviduṣṭarāsaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Wise Agni shall correct our faults and failings, skilled to assign each God his fitting season.
5. When, weak in mind, of feeble understanding, mortals bethink them not of sacrificing,
paragraphs.original: यत्पाकत्रा मनसा दीनदक्षा न यज्ञस्य मन्वते मर्त्यासः ।
paragraphs.translit: yatpākatrā manasā dīnadakṣā na yajñasya manvate martyāsaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Then shall the prudent and discerning Agni worship the Gods, best worshipper, in season.
6. Because the Father hath produced thee, Leader of all our solemn rites, their brilliant Banner:
paragraphs.original: विश्वेषां ह्यध्वराणामनीकं चित्रं केतुं जनिता त्वा जजान ।
paragraphs.translit: viśveṣāṃ hyadhvarāṇāmanīkaṃ citraṃ ketuṃ janitā tvā jajāna |

paragraphs.text: So win by worship pleasant homes abounding in heroes, and rich food to nourish all men.
paragraphs.original: स आ यजस्व नृवतीरनु क्षा स्पार्हा इषः क्षुमतीर्विश्वजन्याः
paragraphs.translit: sa ā yajasva nṛvatīranu kṣā spārhā iṣaḥ kṣumatīrviśvajanyāḥ

paragraphs.text: 7. Thou whom the Heaven and Earth, thou whom the Waters, and Tvastar, maker of fair things, created,
paragraphs.original: यं त्वा द्यावापृथिवी यं त्वापस्त्वष्टा यं त्वा सुजनिमा जजान ।
paragraphs.translit: yaṃ tvā dyāvāpṛthivī yaṃ tvāpastvaṣṭā yaṃ tvā sujanimā jajāna |

paragraphs.text: Well knowing, all along the Fathers' pathway, shine with resplendent light, enkindled, Agni.
paragraphs.original: पन्थामनु प्रविद्वान्पितृयाणं द्युमदग्ने समिधानो वि भाहि
paragraphs.translit: panthāmanu pravidvānpitṛyāṇaṃ dyumadagne samidhāno vi bhāhi
